# BBL Take-Home — Bookmarks & Collections Monorepo Plan

## Context

Empty dir `/Users/REDACTED/Desktop/chun/bbl` → full AI-assisted candidate take-home:
NestJS + TypeScript backend (Auth0 OIDC on every route, Prisma + PostgreSQL) and Vite + React + TS
frontend (React Router ≥ v8, MUI ≥ v9). Submission graded on code AND process artifacts
(CLAUDE.md, .agent/, API_DESIGN.md, DECISIONS.md, AI_WORKFLOW.md, /transcripts/, README.md,
commit history). Repo → GitHub, CI → GitHub Actions.

⚠️ Ancestor `Desktop/CLAUDE.md` describes an unrelated TypeORM project — ignore it entirely;
this repo gets its own CLAUDE.md (graded deliverable).

## Locked decisions (user-confirmed)

| # | Decision | Choice |
|---|----------|--------|
| 1 | Database | PostgreSQL via docker-compose |
| 2 | Repo/CI | GitHub + GitHub Actions |
| 3 | §3.3 sharing | **Signed-in users only**, read-only, via share token — noted in README |
| 4 | Bonuses | All four: Dockerfile (BE+FE), CI/CD, /all page, full-text search |
| 5 | Token to API | ACCESS token (not ID token) — rationale in README |
| 6 | Collection delete | Bookmarks → uncategorised (`onDelete: SetNull`) + "needs PO clarification" note in README |
| 7 | Cross-user access | 404 (not 403) — no existence leak |

## Auth0 config (assignment-provided)

- Discovery: `https://AUTH0_DOMAIN_REDACTED/.well-known/openid-configuration`
- SPA Client ID: `AUTH0_CLIENT_ID_REDACTED` (Authorization Code + PKCE via @auth0/auth0-react)
- Callback `http://localhost:3000/callback` (FRONTEND route — Vite must run on port 3000, strictPort)
- Logout → `http://localhost:3000`; scope `openid profile email`; audience `AUTH0_AUDIENCE_REDACTED`
- Test user: EMAIL_REDACTED / TEST_PASSWORD_REDACTED
- No tenant admin access → no custom claims → `/me` = validate access token → `/userinfo` → upsert local User by `sub`

## Non-negotiable constraints

1. Vite dev server port 3000 (`server.port: 3000, strictPort: true`).
2. Backend does NOT implement `/callback` — SPA route.
3. Tests never hit live Auth0: locally-signed RS256 tokens + mocked JWKS.
4. Seed↔Auth0 linkage: seed 2 users with fake subs; link real test user by email-match upsert on first login.
5. Package versions: install latest, verify ≥ spec minimums (`npm view react-router version`, `npm view @mui/material version`), record actuals in README.
6. `git init` = step zero; incremental meaningful commits throughout (graded).
7. Capture agent-mistake stories + transcripts IN REAL TIME (can't reconstruct later).

<!-- SECTIONS BELOW FILLED AFTER AGENT TEAM RETURNS -->

## Backend design (agent A — synthesized)

### Stack + auth
- NestJS (latest) + Prisma + Postgres. Backend port **3001** (FE owns 3000).
- **Auth: `passport-jwt` + `jwks-rsa` via global `APP_GUARD`.** Chosen over `jose`: idiomatic Nest, JWKS caching/rate-limit free, and decisive — `jwks-rsa` uses Node classic http so **nock intercepts it in tests**; `jose.createRemoteJWKSet` uses undici fetch which nock can't reliably intercept.
- **No `@Public()` decorator exists anywhere** → "OIDC on every route" true by construction. Consequence: no `/health` endpoint; liveness = container-level (`pg_isready` healthcheck). → DECISIONS.md.
- Env: `AUTH0_ISSUER=https://AUTH0_DOMAIN_REDACTED/` (**trailing slash — Auth0 mints iss with it; classic 401 bug**), `AUTH0_AUDIENCE`, `AUTH0_JWKS_URI` (own var, not derived → tests point it at nocked URL without touching strategy code), `DATABASE_URL`.
- `request.user = { userId, sub, email }` — `userId` = internal DB id; ALL scoping uses it. `@CurrentUser()` param decorator.
- **`/me` + provisioning** (`UsersService.resolveFromToken`): in-memory cache → DB by sub → miss: call `/userinfo` with bearer (scope covers it) → **upsert keyed by email** (relinks seed row's placeholder sub → real sub, same row id, seeded data instantly owned). `/userinfo` hit once per unknown sub per process (Auth0 rate-limits ~5/min).

### Prisma schema (deviations justified in DECISIONS.md)
- **User** {id cuid PK, sub @unique, email @unique, name?} — added model; internal PK not sub-as-PK so first-login relink is a 1-column update, FKs stable.
- **Collection** {id, name, ownerId→User Cascade, timestamps} @@index(ownerId)
- **Bookmark** {id, url, title, notes?, collectionId?→Collection **SetNull**, ownerId→User Cascade, `searchVector Unsupported("tsvector")?`, timestamps} @@index(ownerId, collectionId)
- **CollectionShare** {id, collectionId→Cascade, token @unique, granteeUserId?, createdAt, revokedAt?} @@unique([collectionId, granteeUserId])
- **FTS: raw migration** (`migrate dev --create-only` + hand-add): generated STORED tsvector over title+notes, GIN index. NOT Prisma fullTextSearch preview (unstable API across majors). `Unsupported` field keeps migrate diff honest.

### API contract (all routes Bearer-protected, zero exceptions)
| Route | Verbs | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `/me` | GET | local User row |
| `/collections` | GET, POST | `?name=` contains-filter; paginated |
| `/collections/shared-with-me` | GET | declared BEFORE `/:id` (shadowing) |
| `/collections/:id` | GET, PUT, PATCH, DELETE | GET: owner OR grantee; writes: owner only; DELETE 204 → bookmarks SetNull |
| `/collections/:id/bookmarks` | GET | owner OR grantee |
| `/collections/:id/shares` | POST | mint invite token (only time shown) |
| `/bookmarks` | GET, POST | `?q=` FTS, `?collectionId=`, `?uncategorised=true`; POST with collectionId must resolve owned collection else 404 |
| `/bookmarks/:id` | GET, PUT, PATCH, DELETE | owner only |
| `/shares` | GET | issued shares + state |
| `/shares/:id` | DELETE | revoke (soft, `revokedAt`) |
| `/shares/accept` | POST | body `{token}`; binds grantee |

- Status codes: 201 create, 204 delete, 400 validation, 401 token problems, **404 for nonexistent AND cross-user** (single code path: scoped `findFirst` → null → NotFound; leak structurally impossible), 409 share conflicts.
- Error envelope: **Nest default** `{statusCode, message, error}` — documented, not customized. → DECISIONS.md.
- Pagination: **page-based** `?page&limit(≤100)`, response `{data, meta:{page,limit,total,totalPages}}`. Cursor rejected (scale not needed, FE wants page X/Y).
- Validation: **class-validator DTOs**, global ValidationPipe `{whitelist, forbidNonWhitelisted, transform}`. PATCH = `PartialType(CreateDto)`; PUT = full replace, omitted optionals → null (document). `@IsUrl({require_protocol:true})`.

### Shares (read-only, signed-in only)
- Token `crypto.randomBytes(32).toString('base64url')`, stored raw (hashing = documented skipped hardening).
- Single-use invite: accept checks not-revoked + unclaimed + grantee≠owner; same-user re-accept idempotent 200; different user 409.
- **Read-only structural, not conditional**: read queries `OR:[{ownerId},{shares:{some:{granteeUserId, revokedAt:null}}}]`; write queries `{id, ownerId}` only → grantee writes find nothing → 404. No role check to forget.
- Grant = collection + its bookmarks; uncategorised never shareable.

### FTS query
`$queryRaw` tagged template: `websearch_to_tsquery('english', q)` (tolerates arbitrary input), `ts_rank` order, `count(*) OVER()` for meta. **`"ownerId" = ${userId}` inside raw SQL = most dangerous line in codebase** — dedicated cross-user e2e test.

### Seed (`prisma/seed.ts`, idempotent upserts)
- User 1: `EMAIL_REDACTED`, placeholder sub `auth0|seed-candidate` → relinked on first real login via email-match. 3 collections, ~8 bookmarks + 2 uncategorised, searchable phrases in titles/notes.
- User 2: `EMAIL_REDACTED`, sub `auth0|seed-user-2`, never logs in — proves privacy scoping. 2 collections, 4+1 bookmarks.
- One pre-accepted share (user2's collection → user1) so "shared with me" populated on first login.

### Tests
- **Harness** (`test/utils/test-auth.ts`): jose generateKeyPair RS256 → JWK with kid → nock `/.well-known/jwks.json` + sub-aware `/userinfo` stub → `nock.disableNetConnect()` (+ allow 127.0.0.1) → `signToken(claims)` helper. Exercises REAL jwks-rsa path. Test DB on compose Postgres, migrate deploy in globalSetup, truncate between suites.
- **E2E invariants (supertest, primary layer):** ① 401 matrix (none/expired/wrong-aud/wrong-iss-no-trailing-slash) ② privacy scoping every list ③ 404-not-403 cross-user, body indistinguishable ④ share accept/read/write-404/revoke/non-grantee-404 ⑤ delete collection → bookmarks survive with null collectionId ⑥ FTS cross-user scoping (user B seeds exact phrase — must NOT leak) ⑦ provisioning/relink + userinfo-called-once cache assertion ⑧ validation 400s.
- **Unit (thin):** resolveFromToken branches, SharesService.accept edges, pagination clamping.
- **Deliberately NOT tested (graded signal, state in README):** live Auth0 (non-hermetic), Prisma internals/migration SQL (vendor; behavioral outcome e2e'd), Nest DI plumbing, controllers-as-units (pure delegation), class-validator's own rules.

### Docker
- Multi-stage `node:22-slim` (Debian — Prisma engines flake on Alpine/musl): deps+prisma generate → build → runner with dist+prisma, `CMD npx prisma migrate deploy && node dist/main.js`. Verify LTS tag at impl time.
- Root `docker-compose.yml`: `db` (postgres:16, volume, pg_isready healthcheck), `backend` (3001, depends_on healthy), `frontend` (3000). Seed = manual `docker compose exec backend npx prisma db seed` (one README command).

## Frontend design (agent B — synthesized; share contract aligned to backend)

### Versions (agent-verified against npm 2026-08-15 — re-verify at impl time, record in README)
react-router **8.3.0** (≥8 ✓), @mui/material **9.3.1** (≥9 ✓), @auth0/auth0-react 2.24, @tanstack/react-query 5.x, vite 8.x, react 19.2.x, msw 2.x, vitest 4.x.
**RR v8 traps:** `react-router-dom` package NO LONGER EXISTS — `RouterProvider` from `react-router/dom`, everything else from `react-router` (Auth0 quickstarts won't compile). Engines: React ≥19.2.7, Node ≥22.22 → `node:22-alpine` FE image OK (no Prisma).

### Stack picks (each → DECISIONS.md)
- **TanStack Query v5** over plain fetch: graded flows are create/delete→fresh list = cache invalidation; `useMutation`+`invalidateQueries` = 2 lines. Defaults `staleTime:30s, retry:1, refetchOnWindowFocus:false`.
- **Data-mode `createBrowserRouter`, NO loaders** — `getAccessTokenSilently` lives in React context; authenticated loaders would force hoisting Auth0 client out of React. Query-in-component pairs with TanStack.
- **Plain controlled forms** (2–3 fields each) — no react-hook-form; judgment call is graded signal.
- **Types duplicated** in `src/api/types.ts` — shared package = workspaces tooling for ~4 interfaces.
- MUI: collections = Card grid, bookmarks = Table (deliberately different — judgment). Avoid MUI `Grid` (API churn); `Stack`/`Box` grid. Create = dialogs on list pages. Shared ConfirmDialog for deletes. Custom ~40-line SnackbarContext over notistack.
- `.env.example` ships REAL Auth0 values (SPA client id public by design; zero grader friction) — deliberate, documented.

### Auth wiring (load-bearing details)
- `vite.config.ts`: `server: { port: 3000, strictPort: true, proxy: { '/api': 'http://localhost:3001' } }` — **backend sets global prefix `api`** so proxy is pass-through (coordination point).
- Auth0Provider above router; **module-scope router** + `onRedirectCallback: (s) => router.navigate(s?.returnTo ?? '/collections', {replace:true})` — auth0-react default uses `history.replaceState` which data router never observes; post-login restore silently breaks without this. README sentence.
- `authorizationParams: { redirect_uri: origin+'/callback', audience, scope: 'openid profile email' }` → bare `getAccessTokenSilently()` returns ACCESS token for API audience. `useRefreshTokens` + **`useRefreshTokensFallback: true`** (no tenant admin access → can't verify refresh-token grant enabled on this SPA client; without fallback, silent renewal throws `missing_refresh_token` after first expiry) + `cacheLocation:'localstorage'` (third-party-cookie iframe flakiness; XSS tradeoff documented).
- **AuthGuard layout route**: redirect only after `isLoading` settles (else redirect loop); `useRef` guard for StrictMode double-effect; `appState.returnTo = pathname+search`.
- CallbackPage public sibling route: spinner + `useAuth0().error` display + retry; never navigates itself.
- Logout: `logout({logoutParams:{returnTo: window.location.origin}})` → matches registered `http://localhost:3000`.
- Identity display: Auth0 `user` object (email/picture); `/me` exists as API check — document choice.

### API client
`createApiClient(getToken)` factory (testable sans Auth0): single `request<T>` — Bearer inject, JSON body, maps Nest error envelope (`message: string|string[]`) → `ApiError(status,msg,body)`, 204→undefined. `useApi` = `useMemo` over `getAccessTokenSilently`. Per-feature hooks own query keys + invalidation (`bookmarkKeys.list({collectionId,q})`).

### Routes
| Path | Access | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `/callback` | public | outside guard |
| `/` | guarded | → `/collections` |
| `/collections`, `/collections/:id` | guarded | list+create dialog+delete; detail = info + its bookmarks + Share button |
| `/bookmarks`, `/bookmarks/:id` | guarded | table + collection filter Select (URL-driven `?collectionId=` via useSearchParams) + `?q=` search box (debounced 300ms) |
| `/all` | guarded | bonus — client-side composition of the two list queries grouped by collectionId (no invented backend contract) |
| `/shared` | guarded | redeem page: paste token → `POST /shares/accept` → navigate to `/collections/:id` |
| `*` | guarded | NotFound |

**Share flow (aligned to backend accept-model):** owner: ShareCollectionDialog → `POST /collections/:id/shares` → display token + copy button. Recipient: `/shared` paste-token → `POST /shares/accept` → collection now readable via normal routes; `/collections` page also lists "Shared with me" section from `GET /collections/shared-with-me`. Read-only rendering: `readOnly` prop suppresses all mutating controls, driven by `ownerId !== me.id` (FE fetches `/me` once) — backend may add `isOwner` flag as defense-in-depth (nice-to-have).

### Env/config
`src/config.ts` fail-fast validates `VITE_AUTH0_DOMAIN/CLIENT_ID/AUDIENCE`, `VITE_API_BASE_URL` (default `''` = same-origin; dev = Vite proxy, prod = nginx proxy → **no CORS anywhere**). `redirect_uri` derived from origin, not env.

Tested: ① AuthGuard matrix (unauth→loginWithRedirect w/ returnTo; loading→no redirect; auth→outlet) ② collections list render + empty state ③ create-bookmark flow through cache (POST body asserted in handler + list refetch shows row — proves invalidation) ④ filter/search updates URL param + filtered DOM ⑤ ApiError envelope mapping unit.

# BBL Take-Home — Bookmarks & Collections Monorepo Plan

## Context

Empty dir `/Users/REDACTED/Desktop/chun/bbl` → full AI-assisted candidate take-home:
NestJS + TypeScript backend (Auth0 OIDC on every route, Prisma + PostgreSQL) and Vite + React + TS
frontend (React Router ≥ v8, MUI ≥ v9). Submission graded on code AND process artifacts
(CLAUDE.md, .agent/, API_DESIGN.md, DECISIONS.md, AI_WORKFLOW.md, /transcripts/, README.md,
commit history). Repo → GitHub, CI → GitHub Actions.

⚠️ Ancestor `Desktop/CLAUDE.md` describes an unrelated TypeORM project — ignore it entirely;
this repo gets its own CLAUDE.md (graded deliverable).

## Locked decisions (user-confirmed)

| # | Decision | Choice |
|---|----------|--------|
| 1 | Database | PostgreSQL via docker-compose |
| 2 | Repo/CI | GitHub + GitHub Actions |
| 3 | §3.3 sharing | **Signed-in users only**, read-only, via share token — noted in README |
| 4 | Bonuses | All four: Dockerfile (BE+FE), CI/CD, /all page, full-text search |
| 5 | Token to API | ACCESS token (not ID token) — rationale in README |
| 6 | Collection delete | Bookmarks → uncategorised (`onDelete: SetNull`) + "needs PO clarification" note in README |
| 7 | Cross-user access | 404 (not 403) — no existence leak |

## Auth0 config (assignment-provided)

- Discovery: `https://AUTH0_DOMAIN_REDACTED/.well-known/openid-configuration`
- SPA Client ID: `AUTH0_CLIENT_ID_REDACTED` (Authorization Code + PKCE via @auth0/auth0-react)
- Callback `http://localhost:3000/callback` (FRONTEND route — Vite must run on port 3000, strictPort)
- Logout → `http://localhost:3000`; scope `openid profile email`; audience `AUTH0_AUDIENCE_REDACTED`
- Test user: EMAIL_REDACTED / TEST_PASSWORD_REDACTED
- No tenant admin access → no custom claims → `/me` = validate access token → `/userinfo` → upsert local User by `sub`

## Non-negotiable constraints

1. Vite dev server port 3000 (`server.port: 3000, strictPort: true`).
2. Backend does NOT implement `/callback` — SPA route.
3. Tests never hit live Auth0: locally-signed RS256 tokens + mocked JWKS.
4. Seed↔Auth0 linkage: seed 2 users with fake subs; link real test user by email-match upsert on first login.
5. Package versions: install latest, verify ≥ spec minimums (`npm view react-router version`, `npm view @mui/material version`), record actuals in README.
6. `git init` = step zero; incremental meaningful commits throughout (graded).
7. Capture agent-mistake stories + transcripts IN REAL TIME (can't reconstruct later).

<!-- SECTIONS BELOW FILLED AFTER AGENT TEAM RETURNS -->

## Backend design (agent A — synthesized)

### Stack + auth
- NestJS (latest) + Prisma + Postgres. Backend port **3001** (FE owns 3000).
- **Auth: `passport-jwt` + `jwks-rsa` via global `APP_GUARD`.** Chosen over `jose`: idiomatic Nest, JWKS caching/rate-limit free, and decisive — `jwks-rsa` uses Node classic http so **nock intercepts it in tests**; `jose.createRemoteJWKSet` uses undici fetch which nock can't reliably intercept.
- **No `@Public()` decorator exists anywhere** → "OIDC on every route" true by construction. Consequence: no `/health` endpoint; liveness = container-level (`pg_isready` healthcheck). → DECISIONS.md.
- Env: `AUTH0_ISSUER=https://AUTH0_DOMAIN_REDACTED/` (**trailing slash — Auth0 mints iss with it; classic 401 bug**), `AUTH0_AUDIENCE`, `AUTH0_JWKS_URI` (own var, not derived → tests point it at nocked URL without touching strategy code), `DATABASE_URL`.
- `request.user = { userId, sub, email }` — `userId` = internal DB id; ALL scoping uses it. `@CurrentUser()` param decorator.
- **`/me` + provisioning** (`UsersService.resolveFromToken`): in-memory cache → DB by sub → miss: call `/userinfo` with bearer (scope covers it) → **upsert keyed by email** (relinks seed row's placeholder sub → real sub, same row id, seeded data instantly owned). `/userinfo` hit once per unknown sub per process (Auth0 rate-limits ~5/min).

### Prisma schema (deviations justified in DECISIONS.md)
- **User** {id cuid PK, sub @unique, email @unique, name?} — added model; internal PK not sub-as-PK so first-login relink is a 1-column update, FKs stable.
- **Collection** {id, name, ownerId→User Cascade, timestamps} @@index(ownerId)
- **Bookmark** {id, url, title, notes?, collectionId?→Collection **SetNull**, ownerId→User Cascade, `searchVector Unsupported("tsvector")?`, timestamps} @@index(ownerId, collectionId)
- **CollectionShare** {id, collectionId→Cascade, token @unique, granteeUserId?, createdAt, revokedAt?} @@unique([collectionId, granteeUserId])
- **FTS: raw migration** (`migrate dev --create-only` + hand-add): generated STORED tsvector over title+notes, GIN index. NOT Prisma fullTextSearch preview (unstable API across majors). `Unsupported` field keeps migrate diff honest.

### API contract (all routes Bearer-protected, zero exceptions)
| Route | Verbs | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `/me` | GET | local User row |
| `/collections` | GET, POST | `?name=` contains-filter; paginated |
| `/collections/shared-with-me` | GET | declared BEFORE `/:id` (shadowing) |
| `/collections/:id` | GET, PUT, PATCH, DELETE | GET: owner OR grantee; writes: owner only; DELETE 204 → bookmarks SetNull |
| `/collections/:id/bookmarks` | GET | owner OR grantee |
| `/collections/:id/shares` | POST | mint invite token (only time shown) |
| `/bookmarks` | GET, POST | `?q=` FTS, `?collectionId=`, `?uncategorised=true`; POST with collectionId must resolve owned collection else 404 |
| `/bookmarks/:id` | GET, PUT, PATCH, DELETE | owner only |
| `/shares` | GET | issued shares + state |
| `/shares/:id` | DELETE | revoke (soft, `revokedAt`) |
| `/shares/accept` | POST | body `{token}`; binds grantee |

- Status codes: 201 create, 204 delete, 400 validation, 401 token problems, **404 for nonexistent AND cross-user** (single code path: scoped `findFirst` → null → NotFound; leak structurally impossible), 409 share conflicts.
- Error envelope: **Nest default** `{statusCode, message, error}` — documented, not customized. → DECISIONS.md.
- Pagination: **page-based** `?page&limit(≤100)`, response `{data, meta:{page,limit,total,totalPages}}`. Cursor rejected (scale not needed, FE wants page X/Y).
- Validation: **class-validator DTOs**, global ValidationPipe `{whitelist, forbidNonWhitelisted, transform}`. PATCH = `PartialType(CreateDto)`; PUT = full replace, omitted optionals → null (document). `@IsUrl({require_protocol:true})`.

### Shares (read-only, signed-in only)
- Token `crypto.randomBytes(32).toString('base64url')`, stored raw (hashing = documented skipped hardening).
- Single-use invite: accept checks not-revoked + unclaimed + grantee≠owner; same-user re-accept idempotent 200; different user 409.
- **Read-only structural, not conditional**: read queries `OR:[{ownerId},{shares:{some:{granteeUserId, revokedAt:null}}}]`; write queries `{id, ownerId}` only → grantee writes find nothing → 404. No role check to forget.
- Grant = collection + its bookmarks; uncategorised never shareable.

### FTS query
`$queryRaw` tagged template: `websearch_to_tsquery('english', q)` (tolerates arbitrary input), `ts_rank` order, `count(*) OVER()` for meta. **`"ownerId" = ${userId}` inside raw SQL = most dangerous line in codebase** — dedicated cross-user e2e test.

### Seed (`prisma/seed.ts`, idempotent upserts)
- User 1: `EMAIL_REDACTED`, placeholder sub `auth0|seed-candidate` → relinked on first real login via email-match. 3 collections, ~8 bookmarks + 2 uncategorised, searchable phrases in titles/notes.
- User 2: `EMAIL_REDACTED`, sub `auth0|seed-user-2`, never logs in — proves privacy scoping. 2 collections, 4+1 bookmarks.
- One pre-accepted share (user2's collection → user1) so "shared with me" populated on first login.

### Tests
- **Harness** (`test/utils/test-auth.ts`): jose generateKeyPair RS256 → JWK with kid → nock `/.well-known/jwks.json` + sub-aware `/userinfo` stub → `nock.disableNetConnect()` (+ allow 127.0.0.1) → `signToken(claims)` helper. Exercises REAL jwks-rsa path. Test DB on compose Postgres, migrate deploy in globalSetup, truncate between suites.
- **E2E invariants (supertest, primary layer):** ① 401 matrix (none/expired/wrong-aud/wrong-iss-no-trailing-slash) ② privacy scoping every list ③ 404-not-403 cross-user, body indistinguishable ④ share accept/read/write-404/revoke/non-grantee-404 ⑤ delete collection → bookmarks survive with null collectionId ⑥ FTS cross-user scoping (user B seeds exact phrase — must NOT leak) ⑦ provisioning/relink + userinfo-called-once cache assertion ⑧ validation 400s.
- **Unit (thin):** resolveFromToken branches, SharesService.accept edges, pagination clamping.
- **Deliberately NOT tested (graded signal, state in README):** live Auth0 (non-hermetic), Prisma internals/migration SQL (vendor; behavioral outcome e2e'd), Nest DI plumbing, controllers-as-units (pure delegation), class-validator's own rules.

### Docker
- Multi-stage `node:22-slim` (Debian — Prisma engines flake on Alpine/musl): deps+prisma generate → build → runner with dist+prisma, `CMD npx prisma migrate deploy && node dist/main.js`. Verify LTS tag at impl time.
- Root `docker-compose.yml`: `db` (postgres:16, volume, pg_isready healthcheck), `backend` (3001, depends_on healthy), `frontend` (3000). Seed = manual `docker compose exec backend npx prisma db seed` (one README command).

## Frontend design (agent B — synthesized; share contract aligned to backend)

### Versions (agent-verified against npm 2026-08-15 — re-verify at impl time, record in README)
react-router **8.3.0** (≥8 ✓), @mui/material **9.3.1** (≥9 ✓), @auth0/auth0-react 2.24, @tanstack/react-query 5.x, vite 8.x, react 19.2.x, msw 2.x, vitest 4.x.
**RR v8 traps:** `react-router-dom` package NO LONGER EXISTS — `RouterProvider` from `react-router/dom`, everything else from `react-router` (Auth0 quickstarts won't compile). Engines: React ≥19.2.7, Node ≥22.22 → `node:22-alpine` FE image OK (no Prisma).

### Stack picks (each → DECISIONS.md)
- **TanStack Query v5** over plain fetch: graded flows are create/delete→fresh list = cache invalidation; `useMutation`+`invalidateQueries` = 2 lines. Defaults `staleTime:30s, retry:1, refetchOnWindowFocus:false`.
- **Data-mode `createBrowserRouter`, NO loaders** — `getAccessTokenSilently` lives in React context; authenticated loaders would force hoisting Auth0 client out of React. Query-in-component pairs with TanStack.
- **Plain controlled forms** (2–3 fields each) — no react-hook-form; judgment call is graded signal.
- **Types duplicated** in `src/api/types.ts` — shared package = workspaces tooling for ~4 interfaces.
- MUI: collections = Card grid, bookmarks = Table (deliberately different — judgment). Avoid MUI `Grid` (API churn); `Stack`/`Box` grid. Create = dialogs on list pages. Shared ConfirmDialog for deletes. Custom ~40-line SnackbarContext over notistack.
- **Notifications (user-mandated — EVERY action gets feedback):** success snackbar on every mutation — bookmark created/updated/deleted, collection created/updated/deleted, share token created, share accepted, share revoked, token/link copied. Error snackbar on every failed mutation showing `ApiError.message`. Wire once in each mutation hook's `onSuccess`/`onError` (features/*/api.ts) so pages can't forget. Read/query errors → inline `ErrorAlert` + Retry, not snackbar. FE test suite: add one assertion that create-bookmark success shows snackbar.
- `.env.example` ships REAL Auth0 values (SPA client id public by design; zero grader friction) — deliberate, documented.

### Auth wiring (load-bearing details)
- `vite.config.ts`: `server: { port: 3000, strictPort: true, proxy: { '/api': 'http://localhost:3001' } }` — **backend sets global prefix `api`** so proxy is pass-through (coordination point).
- Auth0Provider above router; **module-scope router** + `onRedirectCallback: (s) => router.navigate(s?.returnTo ?? '/collections', {replace:true})` — auth0-react default uses `history.replaceState` which data router never observes; post-login restore silently breaks without this. README sentence.
- `authorizationParams: { redirect_uri: origin+'/callback', audience, scope: 'openid profile email' }` → bare `getAccessTokenSilently()` returns ACCESS token for API audience. `useRefreshTokens` + **`useRefreshTokensFallback: true`** (no tenant admin access → can't verify refresh-token grant enabled on this SPA client; without fallback, silent renewal throws `missing_refresh_token` after first expiry) + `cacheLocation:'localstorage'` (third-party-cookie iframe flakiness; XSS tradeoff documented).
- **AuthGuard layout route**: redirect only after `isLoading` settles (else redirect loop); `useRef` guard for StrictMode double-effect; `appState.returnTo = pathname+search`.
- CallbackPage public sibling route: spinner + `useAuth0().error` display + retry; never navigates itself.
- Logout: `logout({logoutParams:{returnTo: window.location.origin}})` → matches registered `http://localhost:3000`.
- Identity display: Auth0 `user` object (email/picture); `/me` exists as API check — document choice.

### API client
`createApiClient(getToken)` factory (testable sans Auth0): single `request<T>` — Bearer inject, JSON body, maps Nest error envelope (`message: string|string[]`) → `ApiError(status,msg,body)`, 204→undefined. `useApi` = `useMemo` over `getAccessTokenSilently`. Per-feature hooks own query keys + invalidation (`bookmarkKeys.list({collectionId,q})`).

### Routes
| Path | Access | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `/callback` | public | outside guard |
| `/` | guarded | → `/collections` |
| `/collections`, `/collections/:id` | guarded | list+create dialog+delete; detail = info + its bookmarks + Share button |
| `/bookmarks`, `/bookmarks/:id` | guarded | table + collection filter Select (URL-driven `?collectionId=` via useSearchParams) + `?q=` search box (debounced 300ms) |
| `/all` | guarded | bonus — client-side composition of the two list queries grouped by collectionId (no invented backend contract) |
| `/shared` | guarded | redeem page: paste token → `POST /shares/accept` → navigate to `/collections/:id` |
| `*` | guarded | NotFound |

**Share flow (aligned to backend accept-model):** owner: ShareCollectionDialog → `POST /collections/:id/shares` → display token + copy button. Recipient: `/shared` paste-token → `POST /shares/accept` → collection now readable via normal routes; `/collections` page also lists "Shared with me" section from `GET /collections/shared-with-me`. Read-only rendering: `readOnly` prop suppresses all mutating controls, driven by `ownerId !== me.id` (FE fetches `/me` once) — backend may add `isOwner` flag as defense-in-depth (nice-to-have).

### Env/config
`src/config.ts` fail-fast validates `VITE_AUTH0_DOMAIN/CLIENT_ID/AUDIENCE`, `VITE_API_BASE_URL` (default `''` = same-origin; dev = Vite proxy, prod = nginx proxy → **no CORS anywhere**). `redirect_uri` derived from origin, not env.

### Tests (Vitest + RTL + MSW 2.x)
Infra: msw server (`onUnhandledRequest:'error'`), `vi.mock('@auth0/auth0-react')` controllable mock, `renderWithProviders` (fresh QueryClient retry:0 + createMemoryRouter).
Tested: ① AuthGuard matrix (unauth→loginWithRedirect w/ returnTo; loading→no redirect; auth→outlet) ② collections list render + empty state ③ create-bookmark flow through cache (POST body asserted in handler + list refetch shows row — proves invalidation) ④ filter/search updates URL param + filtered DOM ⑤ ApiError envelope mapping unit.
NOT tested (README): MUI internals, Auth0 token machinery (mocked at boundary), real backend contract (MSW encodes assumptions — noted), snapshots. Playwright = stated next step, out of scope.

### Docker
Multi-stage `node:22-alpine` build (VITE_ args baked — Auth0 publics only) → `nginx:1.27-alpine`. nginx.conf: `location /api/ { proxy_pass http://backend:3001; }` + **`try_files $uri /index.html` — without it `/callback` 404s in prod (most-missed item)**. `docker run -p 3000:80`.

## Delivery/docs/process (agent C — synthesized; conflicts resolved)

**Conflict resolutions (agent C vs assignment/agent A — these win):** FE = port 3000 (registered callback), BE = 3001. Both PUT (full replace) AND PATCH (assignment requires both). No `/health` endpoint. `node:22-slim` not alpine (Prisma musl flake). Pagination = page-based `?page&limit` (agent A). Share flow = mint + `POST /shares/accept` (agent A).

### Monorepo tooling (ADR-001)
Plain `/backend` + `/frontend` dirs, **no npm workspaces**. Root `package.json` = `concurrently` scripts only. Rejected workspaces: hoisting complicates per-app Dockerfiles (each `COPY` + `npm ci` own lockfile) + CI caching; zero shared code.

### Real-time capture spine (cannot retrofit — rubric items 3,4,6,7 die without it)
- **`WORKLOG.md`** at root, append-only, created commit 2. Rule (also in CLAUDE.md): every agent correction → 2–3 lines: `date | what agent did wrong | how caught | fix commit`. API_DESIGN "Corrections", AI_WORKFLOW failures, ADR "how-steered" lines all distilled from it at the end.
- Milestone checklist: append WORKLOG → snapshot session JSONL → redact → commit.

### /.agent/ capabilities (2 used + 1 considered-and-cut)
1. **`/api-contract-check` slash command** — canonical def `/.agent/api-contract-check.md`, stub `.claude/commands/api-contract-check.md`. Reads API_DESIGN.md → greps controllers/DTOs (@Get/@Post/@HttpCode/@Query/exceptions) → drift table (route | documented | implemented | DRIFT). No auto-fix; human decides fix-code vs fix-doc commit; drift → WORKLOG. Run before every feature commit. **Generates the "agent's first attempt wrong" evidence.** Paste one real output into the def file.
2. **Pre-commit hook** `/.agent/hooks/pre-commit.sh` via `git config core.hooksPath .agent/hooks`: lint + `tsc --noEmit` + unit tests for staged package. Fires on every commit — honest to document.
3. Considered-and-cut (note in `/.agent/README.md`): per-commit review subagent — duplicates 1+2, performative on solo take-home.

### DECISIONS.md — ADR template + roster
Template: `Context / Decision / Traded away / How the agent was steered` (agent's default + exact constraint that overrode it).
Roster: ADR-001 monorepo tooling · 002 error envelope (Nest default shape, documented not customized) · 003 PUT+PATCH semantics (PUT full-replace, omitted optionals→null) · 004 pagination page-based vs cursor · 005 access-token-not-id-token · 006 /me via /userinfo upsert (no tenant admin → no custom claims) · 007 404-vs-403 · 008 delete→SetNull + PO-clarification note · 009 share = signed-in, read-only, single-use invite token · 010 test auth = local RS256 + mocked JWKS (rejected live tokens in CI, rejected HS256 shortcut) · 011 FTS tsvector+GIN raw migration (rejected ILIKE, external search) · 012 no /health (literal OIDC-every-route) · 013 issuer trailing slash · 014 share tokens stored raw (hardening gap documented).

| Route | Verbs | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `/me` | GET | local User row |
| `/collections` | GET, POST | `?name=` contains-filter; paginated |

## Backend design (agent A — synthesized)

### Stack + auth
- NestJS (latest) + Prisma + Postgres. Backend port **3001** (FE owns 3000).
- **Auth: `passport-jwt` + `jwks-rsa` via global `APP_GUARD`.** Chosen over `jose`: idiomatic Nest, JWKS caching/rate-limit free, and decisive — `jwks-rsa` uses Node classic http so **nock intercepts it in tests**; `jose.createRemoteJWKSet` uses undici fetch which nock can't reliably intercept.
- **No `@Public()` decorator exists anywhere** → "OIDC on every route" true by construction. Consequence: no `/health` endpoint; liveness = container-level (`pg_isready` healthcheck). → DECISIONS.md.
- Env: `AUTH0_ISSUER=https://AUTH0_DOMAIN_REDACTED/` (**trailing slash — Auth0 mints iss with it; classic 401 bug**), `AUTH0_AUDIENCE`, `AUTH0_JWKS_URI` (own var, not derived → tests point it at nocked URL without touching strategy code), `DATABASE_URL`.
- `request.user = { userId, sub, email }` — `userId` = internal DB id; ALL scoping uses it. `@CurrentUser()` param decorator.
- **`/me` + provisioning** (`UsersService.resolveFromToken`): in-memory cache → DB by sub → miss: call `/userinfo` with bearer (scope covers it) → **upsert keyed by email** (relinks seed row's placeholder sub → real sub, same row id, seeded data instantly owned). `/userinfo` hit once per unknown sub per process (Auth0 rate-limits ~5/min).

### Prisma schema (deviations justified in DECISIONS.md)
- **User** {id cuid PK, sub @unique, email @unique, name?} — added model; internal PK not sub-as-PK so first-login relink is a 1-column update, FKs stable.
- **Collection** {id, name, ownerId→User Cascade, timestamps} @@index(ownerId)
- **Bookmark** {id, url, title, notes?, collectionId?→Collection **SetNull**, ownerId→User Cascade, `searchVector Unsupported("tsvector")?`, timestamps} @@index(ownerId, collectionId)
- **CollectionShare** {id, collectionId→Cascade, token @unique, granteeUserId?, createdAt, revokedAt?} @@unique([collectionId, granteeUserId])
- **FTS: raw migration** (`migrate dev --create-only` + hand-add): generated STORED tsvector over title+notes, GIN index. NOT Prisma fullTextSearch preview (unstable API across majors). `Unsupported` field keeps migrate diff honest.

### API contract (all routes Bearer-protected, zero exceptions)
| Route | Verbs | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `/me` | GET | local User row |
| `/collections` | GET, POST | `?name=` contains-filter; paginated |
| `/collections/shared-with-me` | GET | declared BEFORE `/:id` (shadowing) |
| `/collections/:id` | GET, PUT, PATCH, DELETE | GET: owner OR grantee; writes: owner only; DELETE 204 → bookmarks SetNull |
| `/collections/:id/bookmarks` | GET | owner OR grantee |
| `/collections/:id/shares` | POST | mint invite token (only time shown) |
| `/bookmarks` | GET, POST | `?q=` FTS, `?collectionId=`, `?uncategorised=true`; POST with collectionId must resolve owned collection else 404 |
| `/bookmarks/:id` | GET, PUT, PATCH, DELETE | owner only |
| `/shares` | GET | issued shares + state |
| `/shares/:id` | DELETE | revoke (soft, `revokedAt`) |
| `/shares/accept` | POST | body `{token}`; binds grantee |

- Status codes: 201 create, 204 delete, 400 validation, 401 token problems, **404 for nonexistent AND cross-user** (single code path: scoped `findFirst` → null → NotFound; leak structurally impossible), 409 share conflicts.
- Error envelope: **Nest default** `{statusCode, message, error}` — documented, not customized. → DECISIONS.md.
- Pagination: **page-based** `?page&limit(≤100)`, response `{data, meta:{page,limit,total,totalPages}}`. Cursor rejected (scale not needed, FE wants page X/Y).
- Validation: **class-validator DTOs**, global ValidationPipe `{whitelist, forbidNonWhitelisted, transform}`. PATCH = `PartialType(CreateDto)`; PUT = full replace, omitted optionals → null (document). `@IsUrl({require_protocol:true})`.

### Shares (read-only, signed-in only)
- Token `crypto.randomBytes(32).toString('base64url')`, stored raw (hashing = documented skipped hardening).
- Single-use invite: accept checks not-revoked + unclaimed + grantee≠owner; same-user re-accept idempotent 200; different user 409.
- **Read-only structural, not conditional**: read queries `OR:[{ownerId},{shares:{some:{granteeUserId, revokedAt:null}}}]`; write queries `{id, ownerId}` only → grantee writes find nothing → 404. No role check to forget.
- Grant = collection + its bookmarks; uncategorised never shareable.

### FTS query
`$queryRaw` tagged template: `websearch_to_tsquery('english', q)` (tolerates arbitrary input), `ts_rank` order, `count(*) OVER()` for meta. **`"ownerId" = ${userId}` inside raw SQL = most dangerous line in codebase** — dedicated cross-user e2e test.

### Seed (`prisma/seed.ts`, idempotent upserts)
- User 1: `EMAIL_REDACTED`, placeholder sub `auth0|seed-candidate` → relinked on first real login via email-match. 3 collections, ~8 bookmarks + 2 uncategorised, searchable phrases in titles/notes.
- User 2: `EMAIL_REDACTED`, sub `auth0|seed-user-2`, never logs in — proves privacy scoping. 2 collections, 4+1 bookmarks.

- **Deliberately NOT tested (graded signal, state in README):** live Auth0 (non-hermetic), Prisma internals/migration SQL (vendor; behavioral outcome e2e'd), Nest DI plumbing, controllers-as-units (pure delegation), class-validator's own rules.

# Bookmarks & Collections — Agent Rules

Everything a fresh agent session needs to produce on-spec code in this repo. Read this fully before writing code. **DECISIONS.md is authoritative over your defaults** — if it conflicts with what you would normally generate, implement the decision. If you hit a NEW ambiguity: stop, ask, then append an ADR.

## Stack

- **/backend** — NestJS + TypeScript + Prisma + PostgreSQL (docker-compose). Port **3001**, global prefix **`api`**.
- **/frontend** — Vite + React + TypeScript SPA. React Router ≥ v8, MUI ≥ v9, TanStack Query, @auth0/auth0-react. Dev server port **3000, strictPort** (Auth0 callback is registered for `http://localhost:3000/callback` — never change the port).
- Plain two-package repo: independent package.json + lockfile per app. **No npm workspaces** (ADR-001).
- Auth: Auth0 OIDC. The SPA sends the **ACCESS token** (audience `AUTH0_AUDIENCE_REDACTED`) to the API — never the ID token (ADR-005).

## Hard constraints — do not violate, do not "improve"

1. **OIDC on every route.** Global JWT guard; there is NO `@Public()` decorator and none may be added. No `/health` endpoint (ADR-012).
2. **Privacy invariant:** every Collection/Bookmark query is scoped by the internal `userId` resolved from the verified JWT `sub`. Cross-user or nonexistent resource → **404, never 403** (ADR-007). No DTO accepts `ownerId` from the client.
3. **Sharing is signed-in + read-only** (ADR-009): grantees can GET a shared collection and its bookmarks; write paths are owner-scoped queries so grantee writes 404 structurally.
4. **Error envelope** = NestJS default `{ statusCode, message, error }` (ADR-002). Don't wrap it.
5. **PUT = full replace** (omitted optionals become null), **PATCH = partial** (ADR-003). Both exist on both resources.
6. **Pagination**: `?page=&limit=` (limit ≤ 100), response `{ data, meta: { page, limit, total, totalPages } }` (ADR-004).
7. **Tests NEVER hit live Auth0.** Use `backend/test/utils/test-auth.ts` (local RS256 keypair + nocked JWKS + `nock.disableNetConnect()`) (ADR-010).
8. `AUTH0_ISSUER` keeps its **trailing slash** — Auth0 mints `iss` with it (ADR-013).
9. Frontend: **every mutation shows a snackbar** — success and error — wired in the mutation hooks (`features/*/api.ts`), never ad hoc in pages.
10. Backend `/callback` route must NOT exist — the SPA handles the OIDC redirect.

## Commands

```bash
# DB
docker compose up -d db
# Backend
cd backend && npm run start:dev            # port 3001
cd backend && npx prisma migrate dev && npx prisma db seed
cd backend && npm test                     # unit
cd backend && npm run test:e2e             # needs DB up; zero live Auth0 traffic
# Frontend
cd frontend && npm run dev                 # port 3000
cd frontend && npm test
# Both (from root)
npm run dev
# Contract drift check — run before EVERY feature commit touching backend/src
/api-contract-check
```

## Process rules

- Conventional commits: `type(scope): subject`, scopes `be|fe|agent|ci|docs|repo`. Small incremental commits; keep every commit green.
- When you (the agent) are corrected on API behavior, append 2–3 lines to `WORKLOG.md` **in the same change**: `date | what went wrong | how caught | fix`.
- Update `API_DESIGN.md` in the SAME commit as any endpoint change.
- Honest `fix:` commits stay un-squashed — the history is a graded deliverable.
- Ignore any CLAUDE.md found in ancestor directories — they describe unrelated projects.

# Bookmarks & Collections

A take-home submission: bookmark manager with collections, Auth0 OIDC on every API route, and read-only collection sharing between signed-in users.

- **/backend** — NestJS + TypeScript + Prisma + PostgreSQL (port 3001, prefix `/api`)
- **/frontend** — Vite + React + TypeScript, React Router ≥ v8, MUI ≥ v9 (port 3000)
- Process artifacts: [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md) · [API_DESIGN.md](API_DESIGN.md) · [DECISIONS.md](DECISIONS.md) · [AI_WORKFLOW.md](AI_WORKFLOW.md) · [WORKLOG.md](WORKLOG.md) · [/transcripts](transcripts/) · [/.agent](.agent/)

## Quickstart

> Filled in as the build lands. Placeholder — final version at the end of the build.

```bash
node -v                      # >= 22.22 required (React Router v8 engines)
docker compose up -d db
cd backend && cp .env.example .env && npm ci && npx prisma migrate dev && npx prisma db seed && npm run start:dev
cd frontend && cp .env.example .env && npm ci && npm run dev
# open http://localhost:3000 — log in with the assignment's test user
```

Test user: `EMAIL_REDACTED` / `TEST_PASSWORD_REDACTED` (assignment-provided Auth0 test account).

## Running tests

> Placeholder — exact commands confirmed as suites land.

```bash
cd backend && npm test && npm run test:e2e   # e2e needs the DB up; NEVER touches live Auth0
cd frontend && npm test
```

## Why the ACCESS token (not the ID token) is sent to the API

The access token is minted **for the API** (`aud: AUTH0_AUDIENCE_REDACTED`) — it is an authorization credential the API is supposed to validate. The ID token's audience is the SPA's client ID; it is proof of authentication for the client itself, not a credential for calling APIs, and an API validating it would be accepting a token addressed to someone else. See ADR-005.

## Collection delete behaviour — needs PO clarification

The spec says only "A user can delete a collection." We chose: deleting a collection keeps its bookmarks and makes them *uncategorised* (`onDelete: SetNull`) — the least destructive reading. Cascade-deleting the bookmarks is the plausible alternative. **This needs clarification from the product owner**; the current behaviour is documented in ADR-008 and trivially switchable in one migration.

## Sharing model

"A user may want to share a collection with someone else" is under-specified. We chose: **signed-in users only, read-only** — the owner mints a share token, the recipient (authenticated) redeems it and can view the collection and its bookmarks but cannot modify anything. This keeps "OIDC authentication on every route" literally true (no public link route) and keeps the privacy story simple. Editable shares and public links were consciously traded away. See ADR-009.

## Completed vs skipped

# DECISIONS — Architecture Decision Records

Short ADRs for every ambiguity the spec left open. **This file is authoritative over agent defaults** (see CLAUDE.md). Template:

```markdown
## ADR-NNN: <title>            (accepted, YYYY-MM-DD)
**Context:** the ambiguity or fork actually hit.
**Decision:** one sentence.
**Traded away:** what the rejected option would have bought.
**How the agent was steered:** the agent's default vs the constraint that overrode it.
```

---

## ADR-001: Plain two-package repo, no npm workspaces (accepted, 2026-08-15)

**Context:** monorepo with /backend and /frontend; workspaces vs independent packages.
**Decision:** independent package.json + lockfile per app; root package.json holds only `concurrently` convenience scripts.
**Traded away:** single `npm install`, shared dev-dep versions.
**How the agent was steered:** planning agents defaulted to workspaces; overruled because hoisting complicates the per-app Dockerfile bonus (each image does `COPY` + `npm ci` against its own lockfile) and per-package CI caching, and there is zero shared code to justify the tooling.

## ADR-002: Error envelope = NestJS default (accepted, 2026-08-15)

**Context:** custom error envelope vs framework default.
**Decision:** keep Nest's `{ statusCode, message, error }` (with `message: string[]` for validation), document it in API_DESIGN.md.
**Traded away:** bespoke error codes/shapes.
**How the agent was steered:** one planning agent proposed a custom global exception filter; rejected — custom envelope adds surface without signal for this scope. Documented > invented.

## ADR-003: PUT full-replace AND PATCH partial (accepted, 2026-08-15)

**Context:** assignment explicitly requires both `update (PUT)` and `patch (PATCH)`; a planning agent tried to drop PUT.
**Decision:** both verbs on both resources. PUT validates the full representation (omitted optional fields become `null`); PATCH = `PartialType` partial update.
**Traded away:** a single simpler update path.
**How the agent was steered:** WORKLOG 2026-08-15 — caught in plan review against the assignment text; the "PATCH not PUT" ADR the agent drafted was rejected.

## ADR-004: Page-based pagination (accepted, 2026-08-15)

**Context:** list endpoints need pagination; page/limit vs cursor.
**Decision:** `?page=&limit=` (limit ≤ 100), response `{ data, meta: { page, limit, total, totalPages } }`.
**Traded away:** cursor stability under concurrent writes (irrelevant at this scale); the FE gets "page X of Y" for free.
**How the agent was steered:** stated in CLAUDE.md hard constraints so scaffolded list endpoints follow it.

## ADR-005: SPA sends the access token, never the ID token (accepted, 2026-08-15)

**Context:** two tokens come back from Auth0; which one authenticates API calls.
**Decision:** access token with `aud: AUTH0_AUDIENCE_REDACTED`; the API validates issuer + audience + RS256 signature via JWKS.
**Traded away:** the ID token's ready-made profile claims (email/name) — the API resolves profile via `/userinfo` instead (ADR-006).
**How the agent was steered:** requirement fixed by the user up front; encoded in CLAUDE.md; the FE never reads `getIdTokenClaims()` for API calls.

# Mechanical transcript redaction. Usage: ./redact.sh <in.jsonl> <out.jsonl>

  -e 's#/Users/[A-Za-z0-9._-]+#/Users/REDACTED#g' \
  "$IN" > "$OUT"

# /api-contract-check — API contract drift detector

**When:** before every feature commit touching `backend/src`.
**Why:** API_DESIGN.md was written before the code; generated controllers drift (status codes, envelope, params, verbs). Drift caught here becomes WORKLOG evidence and honest fix commits.

## Instructions (for the agent executing this command)

1. Read `API_DESIGN.md`. Extract every documented route: verb + path, success status code, list/filter/pagination params, error behaviours (401/404/409), request/response shapes.
2. Inspect the implementation: grep `backend/src/**/*.controller.ts` for `@Get/@Post/@Put/@Patch/@Delete/@HttpCode`, controller path prefixes, and `backend/src/**/dto/*.ts` for `@Query`/body DTO fields and validation decorators; note exception types thrown in the services.
3. Report a table: `route | documented | implemented | DRIFT?`. For each drift, state which side is wrong (code vs doc) and why.
4. Do **NOT** auto-fix. The human decides: fix code (→ `fix(be):` commit) or fix doc (→ `docs(api):` commit). Either way, append the drift to `WORKLOG.md`.

## Evidence of use

> One real invocation output is pasted here during the build.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Pre-commit gate: lint + typecheck + unit tests for whichever package has staged changes.
# Install: git config core.hooksPath .agent/hooks
# No-ops safely while a package doesn't exist yet (early scaffolding commits).
set -euo pipefail

STAGED=$(git diff --cached --name-only)

check_pkg() {
  local pkg="$1"
  [ -d "$pkg" ] && [ -f "$pkg/package.json" ] || return 0          # package not scaffolded yet
  echo "$STAGED" | grep -q "^$pkg/" || return 0                     # no staged changes in it
  echo "pre-commit: checking $pkg"
  (cd "$pkg" && npm run --silent lint && npx tsc --noEmit && npm test --silent)
}

check_pkg backend
check_pkg frontend
echo "pre-commit: OK"
